chunks.title: Desync Price OC list
chunks.heading: Solution › Desync Price OC list
chunks.text:
Sales -> Purchase Order from buyer -> Desync Price OC list
In this screen, only the data that has been created through the cost sheet will be visible. The destination-wise price is also defined in the cost sheet under the Cost Sheet Summary section.
1. Initial Cost Sheet Setup
Style 1 → Cost Sheet
For Destination India (IN), the selling price is set as 10 in the Cost Sheet.
2. OC Creation – Auto Price Pickup
When creating an OC (Order Confirmation):
• Select Style 1
• Select Destination India (IN)
The system should automatically pick the Selling Price from the confirmed Cost Sheet.
In this case, the Selling Price in OC should automatically populate as:
10
This ensures that the OC Selling Price is directly mapped from the Cost Sheet based on:
• Style
• Destination
3. Cost Sheet Revision
Later, if the Cost Sheet is revised:
• The price for Destination India (IN) is updated from 10 to 15
• The revised Cost Sheet is confirmed
The updated price (15) will now be visible in the Cost Sheet screen.
4. Update OC with Latest Cost Sheet Price
If an OC was already created earlier with price 10, and the Cost Sheet price is revised to 15, then:
Upon clicking:
“Update OC With Latest Costsheet Price”
The system will:
• Fetch the latest confirmed Cost Sheet price
• Automatically update the Selling Price in the OC from 10 to 15
5. Price Display & Range (As Per Image)

chunks.title: Delivery update
chunks.heading: Solution › Delivery update
chunks.text:
Sales -> Purchase order from buyer -> Delivery Update
Editable Fields
In the Purchase Orders from Buyers – Delivery Update screen, the following fields are editable:
• Buyer Delivery Date
• OC Delivery Date
• Buyer Order Date
• PCD Date
• PO Packet Date
• GAC Date
Update Process
• The user can modify the required editable fields directly in the grid.
• After making the necessary changes, click on Save.
System Behavior After Save
• Once saved, the system will update the edited fields.
• The updated values will be reflected in:
• The respective OC (Order Confirmation)
• The related transaction screens
Validation
After updating and saving:
• Verify that the modified dates are correctly updated in the OC.
• Ensure that the latest saved data is visible across all relevant sections.
